The tallest and thickest type of grass is bamboo.

Desertification can be prevented by creating protective belts.

5. सिकन्दर और पोरस की लड़ाई हाइडेस्पीज में हुई थी। 
Alexander and Porus fought the Battle of Hydaspes.

The Battle of Haldighati was fought between Akbar and Maharana Pratap.

Nadir Shah took Shah Jahan’s Peacock Throne in 1739.

Surat is situated on the banks of the Tapi river.

The World Trade Organization came into existence on 1 January 1995.

10. बिक्री कर अप्रत्यक्ष कर का एक उदाहरण है। 
Sales tax is an example of an indirect tax.

"Chandrakanta" is not a work written by Munshi Premchand.

The gharial gets its name from the pot-shaped structure on the male's snout.
